defs.d: Beginning; start.
To start, to initiate or take the first step into something.
defs.ex: I began playing the piano at the age of five.   Now that everyone is here, we should begin the presentation.

defs.d: To be in the first stage of some situation
defs.ex: The program begins at 9 o'clock on the dot.    I rushed to get to class on time, but the lesson had already begun.

defs.d: An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces.
defs.ex: The femur has a clean break and so should heal easily.

defs.d: A physical space that opens up in something or between two things.
defs.ex: He waited minutes for a break in the traffic to cross the highway.

defs.d: To separate into two or more pieces, to fracture or crack, by a process that cannot easily be reversed for reassembly.
defs.ex: If the vase falls to the floor, it might break.

defs.d: To divide (something, often money) into smaller units.
defs.ex: Can you break a hundred-dollar bill for me?

defs.d: Short for mainline.
To mainly play a specific character, or side, during a game.
defs.ex: He mains the same character as me in that game.

defs.d: Of chief or leading importance; prime, principal.
Chief, most important, or principal in extent, size, or strength; consisting of the largest part.
defs.ex: main timbers  main branch of a river  main body of an army

defs.d: Exceedingly, extremely, greatly, mightily, very, very much.
A communication, or what is communicated; any concept or information conveyed.
defs.ex: We've just received an urgent message from the President.

defs.d: An underlying theme or conclusion to be drawn from something.
defs.ex: The main message of the novel is that time heals all wounds.

defs.d: To send a message to; to transmit a message to, e.g. as text via a cell phone.
defs.ex: I messaged her about the concert.

defs.d: To send (something) as a message; usually refers to electronic messaging.
defs.ex: Please message the final report by fax.

defs.d: The master of a house; the head of a family; a householder.
A tiller of the ground; a husbandman.
To manage or administer carefully and frugally; use to the best advantage; economise.
defs.ex: For my means, I'll husband them so well, / They shall go far. — Shakespeare.

defs.d: To conserve.
(physical) An area; somewhere within an area.
A location or position in space.
(frequency) One and only one time.
defs.ex: I have only once eaten pizza.

defs.d: (temporal location) Formerly; during some period in the past.
defs.ex: He was once the most handsome man around.

defs.d: As soon as; when; after.
defs.ex: Once he is married, he will be able to claim the inheritance.

defs.d: The or an act of taking.
Something that is taken; a haul.
To get into one's hands, possession or control, with or without force.
defs.ex: I'll take that plate off the table.

defs.d: To receive or accept (something) (especially something given or bestowed, awarded, etc).
defs.ex: The camera takes 35mm film.

defs.d: To show (someone) the way; to guide, conduct; to point, indicate.
defs.ex: ‘The bliss is there’, mumbled the old man and taught to Heaven.

defs.d: (ditransitive) To pass on knowledge to.
defs.ex: Can you teach me to sew?  Can you teach sewing to me?

defs.d: A writing consisting of multiple glyphs, characters, symbols or sentences.
A book, tome or other set of writings.
To send a text message to; i.e. to transmit text using the Short Message Service (SMS), or a similar service, between communications devices, particularly mobile phones.
defs.ex: I'll text the address to you as soon as I find it.

defs.d: To send and receive text messages.
defs.ex: Have you been texting all afternoon?

defs.d: Someone who is slow; a sluggard.
A slow song.
To make (something) run, move, etc. less quickly; to reduce the speed of.
To keep from going quickly; to hinder the progress of.
Taking a long time to move or go a short distance, or to perform an action; not quick in motion; proceeding at a low speed.
defs.ex: a slow train;  a slow computer

defs.d: Not happening in a short time; spread over a comparatively long time.
The direction opposed to the pull of gravity.
defs.ex: Up is a good way to go.

defs.d: A positive thing.
defs.ex: I hate almost everything about my job. The only up is that it's so close to home.

defs.d: To increase or raise.
defs.ex: If we up the volume, we may be able to hear what he says.

defs.d: To promote.
defs.ex: It wasn’t long before they upped him to Vice President.

defs.d: Facing upwards.
defs.ex: Put the notebook face up on the table.

defs.d: On or at a physically higher level.
defs.ex: The flood waters are up again across large areas of the country.

defs.d: The way a living creature behaves or acts.
defs.ex: She can't stop the strange behaviour because she has OCD (obsessive-compulsive disorder).

defs.d: The way a device or system operates.
The surroundings, circumstances, environment, background or settings that determine, specify, or clarify the meaning of an event or other occurrence.
defs.ex: In what context did your attack on him happen? - We had a pretty tense relationship at the time, and when he insulted me I snapped.

defs.d: The text in which a word or passage appears and which helps ascertain its meaning.
defs.ex: Without any context, I can't tell you if the "dish" refers to the food, or the thing you eat it on.

defs.d: To knit or bind together; to unite closely.
Knit or woven together; close; firm.
The body with the power to make and/or enforce laws to control a country, land area, people or organization.
(grammar) The relationship between a word and its dependents.
A hall.
An act of putting the ball or shuttlecock in play in various games.
defs.ex: Whose serve is it?

defs.d: A portion of food or drink, a serving.
(personal) To provide a service (or, by extension, a product, especially food or drink).
To treat (someone) in a given manner.
A bounding straight edge of a two-dimensional shape.
defs.ex: A square has four sides.

defs.d: A flat surface of a three-dimensional object; a face.
defs.ex: A cube has six sides.

defs.d: To ally oneself, be in an alliance, usually with "with" or rarely "in with"
defs.ex: Which will you side with, good or evil?

defs.d: To lean on one side.
Being on the left or right, or toward the left or right; lateral.
Indirect; oblique; incidental.
defs.ex: a side issue; a side view or remark

defs.d: Advertisement.
defs.ex: I have placed both of the ads in the newspaper as instructed.

defs.d: A set of clothes to be worn together, now especially a man's matching jacket and trousers (also business suit or lounge suit), or a similar outfit for a woman.
defs.ex: Nick hired a navy-blue suit for the wedding.

defs.d: (by extension) A single garment that covers the whole body: space suit, boiler suit, protective suit.
To make proper or suitable; to adapt or fit.
(said of clothes, hairstyle or other fashion item) To be suitable or apt for one's image.
defs.ex: That new top suits you. Where did you buy it?

defs.d: To violate rules in order to gain advantage from a situation.
defs.ex: My brother flunked biology because he cheated on his mid-term.

defs.d: To be unfaithful to one's spouse or partner.
defs.ex: After he found out his wife cheated, he left her.

defs.d: The spirit; the soul of man.
The disembodied soul; the soul or spirit of a deceased person; a spirit appearing after death
defs.ex: Everyone believed that the ghost of an old lady haunted the crypt.

defs.d: To haunt; to appear to in the form of an apparition.
To die; to expire.
Either of the two fleshy protrusions around the opening of the mouth.
A part of the body that resembles a lip, such as the edge of a wound or the labia.
To touch or grasp with the lips; to kiss; to lap the lips against (something).
(of something inanimate) To touch lightly.
An animal's tail.
A men's hairstyle whose primary attribute is a braid or ponytail at the back of the head, such as that worn by men in Imperial China.
To put oneself or itself at the end of a waiting line.
To arrange themselves into a physical waiting queue.
To calm down.
To make something loose.
defs.ex: to relax a rope or cord

defs.d: Having an easy-going mood or temperament.
defs.ex: He's a relaxed kind of guy, he never lets himself get upset.

defs.d: Eased or loosened.
defs.ex: The relaxed rules were greatly tightened after the lawsuit.

defs.d: A place on the coast at which ships can shelter, or dock to load and unload cargo or passengers.
A town or city containing such a place, a port city.
To turn or put to the left or larboard side of a ship; said of the helm.
defs.ex: Port your helm!

defs.d: Of or relating to port, the left-hand side of a vessel when facing the bow.
defs.ex: on the port side

defs.d: The unmowed part of a golf course.
A rude fellow; a coarse bully; a rowdy.
To create in an approximate form.
defs.ex: Rough in the shape first, then polish the details.

defs.d: To commit the offense of roughing, i.e. to punch another player.
Not smooth; uneven.
Approximate; hasty or careless; not finished.
defs.ex: a rough estimate; a rough sketch of a building; a rough plan

defs.d: Close investigation.
An instance of scanning.
defs.ex: The operators vacated the room during the scan.

defs.d: To examine sequentially, carefully, or critically; to scrutinize; to behold closely.
defs.ex: She scanned the passage carefully but could not find what she was looking for.

defs.d: To look about for; to look over quickly.
defs.ex: He scanned the horizon.

defs.d: To quote; to repeat, as a passage from a book, or the words of another.
To list the source(s) from which one took information, words or literary or verbal context.
To make complex; to modify so as to make something intricate or difficult.
To involve in a convoluted matter.
defs.ex: Don't complicate yourself in issues that are beyond the scope of your understanding.

defs.d: Difficult or convoluted.
defs.ex: It seems this complicated situation will not blow over soon.

defs.d: Folded longitudinally (as in the wings of certain insects).
To make ugly
Not beautiful; uncomely; unattractive
Sorrowful; sad
A gentle bend, such as in a road.
defs.ex: You should slow down when approaching a curve.

defs.d: A simple figure containing no straight portions and no angles; a curved line.
defs.ex: She scribbled a curve on the paper.

defs.d: To bend; to crook.
defs.ex: to curve a line

defs.d: To cause to swerve from a straight course.
defs.ex: to curve a ball in pitching it

defs.d: Bent without angles; crooked; curved.
defs.ex: a curve line

defs.d: An argument, or discussion, usually in an ordered or formal setting, often with more than two people, generally ending with a vote or other decision.
defs.ex: After a four-hour debate, the committee voted to table the motion.

defs.d: An informal and spirited but generally civil discussion of opposing views.
defs.ex: The debate over the age of the universe is thousands of years old.

defs.d: To participate in a debate; to dispute, argue, especially in a public arena.
defs.ex: "Debate me, coward!" snarled the completely normal intellectual.

defs.d: To fight.
The visible part of fire; a stream of burning vapour or gas, emitting light and heat.
A romantic partner or lover in a usually short-lived but passionate affair.
To produce flames; to burn with a flame or blaze.
To burst forth like flame; to break out in violence of passion; to be kindled with zeal or ardour.
Of a brilliant reddish orange-gold colour, like that of a flame.
Effort expended on a particular task; toil, work.
That which requires hard work for its accomplishment; that which demands effort.
To toil, to work.
To belabour, to emphasise or expand upon (a point in a debate, etc).
defs.ex: I think we've all got the idea. There's no need to labour the point.

defs.d: In a gradual manner; making slow progress; slowly.
By degrees
A machine that tabulates the amount of sales transactions, makes a permanent and cumulative record of them, and has a drawer in which cash can be kept.
A point of sale.
A formal recording of names, events, transactions etc.
defs.ex: The teacher took the register by calling out each child's name.

defs.d: A book of such entries.
To enter in a register.
To enroll, especially to vote.
Darkness where light, particularly sunlight, is blocked.
defs.ex: The old oak tree gave shade in the heat of the day.

defs.d: Something that blocks light, particularly in a window.
defs.ex: Close the shade, please: it's too bright in here.
